title: Tai Tam Upper Reservoir Masonry Aqueduct
geometryBasis: Aqueduct follows mapped elevated crossing way 403465573 3.04 m from the independently labeled location, perpendicular to road bridge way 300791897.
sectionBasis: Flat thick slab with an open trough between two stone curbs, short molded masonry pier caps, rectangular open bays and light safety rails.
limitations: The distinct mapped centerline and labeled location register the aqueduct. Trough depth, width, pier spacing, colors and embankment junctions are estimates from the distant cleared view and written descriptions.
The 5 m terrain field was preserved. The shallow fall of the trough and the foundations beneath the channel are approximate.
The perpendicular masonry road bridge and the Byewash spillway are separate structures.
